feeds.title: International Mountain Guides
feeds.description: News, Updates, and Featured Expeditions of International Mountain Guides. International Mountain Guides leads ice climbing, trekking, and mountaineering expeditions around the world, from the Cascades to the Himalayas.

feeds.title: Mark Horrell Blog
feeds.description: I am Mark Horrell, an Indie author & mountaineering blogger. My aim is to provide an alternative voice in mountain writing by representing the quiet majority of enthusiastic amateurs who are just happy to get out into the peaks without worrying about being seen to climb in a certain style, with no great talent but heaps of enthusiasm, who believe the mountains should be enjoyed by all people regardless of ability, technique or fortitude.

feeds.title: Pinoy Mountaineer
feeds.description: The online portal for hiking in the Philippines. Pinoy Mountaineer has the most comprehensive list of guides for mountains and outdoor destinations in the country, as well as bulletins to keep you updated with the local mountaineering scene. This blog is authored by Gideon Lasco, physician, anthropologist, writer, and environmental advocate.

feeds.title: UIAA
feeds.description: The UIAA - International Climbing and Mountaineering Federation - was founded in 1932 and has 92 member federations in 69 countries representing over three million people. International Climbing and Mountaineering Federation. The organization's mission is to promote the growth and protection of mountaineering and climbing worldwide, advance safe and ethical mountain practices and promote responsible access, culture and environmental protection.

feeds.title: Madison Mountaineering
feeds.description: Madison Mountaineering is a boutique mountain guide service based in Seattle, Washington. We are a passionate group of climbers, guides, and all around mountain enthusiasts. We specialize in mountaineering expeditions to the 7 Summits and other international and domestic peaks.

feeds.title: Satori Adventures Blog
feeds.description: Satori Adventures Pvt. Ltd. - Leading mountaineering agency in Nepal. Satori Adventures specialized on mountain expedition, peak climbing , trekking, tours, hiking and travel holidays in the Himalayas.

feeds.title: Mountain-Hiking
feeds.description: Discover hundreds of hyper-detailed hiking trail guides and how-to articles written by Sean, a single, experienced hiker—so you can enjoy accurate, reliable trail info, to hike safer, hike better, and hike more. He dedicates his blog to helping you find amazing hikes in the Catskills, Adirondacks & Gunks.

feeds.title: Abacus Mountain Guides Blog
feeds.description: Keep up to date with everything we're up to at Abacus Mountain Guides. Abacus Mountain Guides provide world class mountain adventures on the west coast of Scotland. With the highest qualifications in Mountaineering, Canyoning and Mountain Biking we deliver expert coaching and guiding in the mountains.

feeds.title: Hunter Mountaineering Blog
feeds.description: I'm Max Hunter, owner of Hunter Mountaineering and your mountain professional. I hold the MIC - the highest professional mountaineering instructional qualification in the UK. I'm passionate about climbing and the outdoors and I would love to share my knowledge with you. Find articles on Guiding, Instruction and Coaching in all aspects of British Mountaineering and Climbing.

feeds.title: 2018 Mountaineering Season
feeds.description: Alaska Mountaineering School (AMS) promotes excellence in responsible mountaineering and wilderness travel though education and guiding. Our core principles are safety, Leave No Trace, leadership, teamwork, skills, and enjoyment. AMS' course progression and hands-on approach teaches confidence based on knowledge. We support a strong foundation that results in a lifetime of enjoyment of the outdoors.

feeds.title: Beyond the Edge
feeds.description: Walk, Scramble, Climb, Navigate and more with one of the UK's most experienced providers of mountaineering training courses including Hill and Moorland Leader, Mountain Leader, Rock Climbing Instructor and Climbing Wall Instructor qualifications.

feeds.title: The Next Summit Mountaineering Blog
feeds.description: The Next Summit is dedicated to helping people hike, camp and climb the mountains of the American West safely and without leaving a trace.

feeds.title: Peak Mountaineering Blog
feeds.description: Peak Mountaineering was formed by Paul Lewis to provide high quality mountain activities and training with small group sizes, flexible course itineraries and a personal approach.

feeds.title: Mountain Trip Blog
feeds.description: Your premier provider for mountain climbing expeditions, climbing instruction and adventures, including trekking, private climbs, and technical climbs. Find news, trip reports, guide tips, articles and gear reviews. Stay connected with Mountain Trip with news from Denali, Everest, and Telluride Colorado.

feeds.title: Great Escape. Nick Bullock.
feeds.description: Blog by Nick Bullock. Get posts on Mountaineering, Alpine Climbing, Rock, Ice & Mixed Climbing.

feeds.title: OSM Adventures - One Smart Mountaineer
feeds.description: A mountaineering blog, with climbs boiled down to a few minutes each.

feeds.title: Irish Seven Summits Mountain Blog
feeds.description: Irish amateur attempt to complete the Seven Summits Challenge (highest peak on all seven continents).

feeds.title: Tarmachan Mountaineering
feeds.description: Based in Aviemore, The Cairngorms, Highlands of Scotland. Gary Hodgson runs Tarmachan Mountaineering, providing instruction and guided walking all year round. This is my regularly updated blog including the latest snow conditions in winter.

feeds.title: Colorado Mountaineering
feeds.description: Welcome to Colorado Mountaineering, a website dedicated to providing practical and entertaining information on mountaineering, hiking, and climbing in the high mountains of Colorado. It is the goal of Colorado Mountaineering to impart an empirical sense of the Colorado mountaineering experience. These articles include trip reports, photos, rout description, mountain profiles, advice, how-to pieces, news stories and more.

feeds.title: The Armchair Mountaineer Blog
feeds.description: The Armchair Mountaineer finds inspiration in the adventure travel, the world's wild places, and especially mountains. I want to help and inspire others to spend their time outside the office in the pursuit of a life more adventurous and more rewarding.

feeds.title: The Mountaineers Blog
feeds.description: Keep up to date with the latest news and information in The Mountaineers' official blog. The mission of the Mountaineers is to enrich the community by helping people explore, conserve, learn about and enjoy the lands and waters of the Pacific Northwest.

feeds.title: The Next Summit
feeds.description: I'm Alex Derr. I created this website to help share advice, stories, history and reflections from my time in the mountains. If you like what you see, please follow me on social media or subscribe for email updates!
